legend: Wandering past the fresh produce, Busy Beaver's attention is captured by the local dairy vendor with a peculiar board game at his stall.

There is a circular board with N%%ZSMJ0%% squares numbered from 0%%ZSMJ1%% to N−1%%ZSMJ2%%. Busy Beaver plays a game on this board with an N%%ZSMJ3%% sided die labelled from 0%%ZSMJ4%% to N−1%%ZSMJ5%%. If he is on square s%%ZSMJ6%% and moves by t%%ZSMJ7%% steps, he will land directly on the square s+t \pmod N%%ZSMJ8%%.
There is also one magical portal on the board, such that if the player lands exactly on square X%%ZSMJ9%%, they are instantly teleported to square Y%%ZSMJ10%%.

Busy Beaver rolls the die K%%ZSMJ11%% times and obtains the sequence a_1, a_2, \dots, a_K%%ZSMJ12%%. From his initial square, Busy Beaver will move by a_1%%ZSMJ13%% steps, then by a_2%%ZSMJ14%% steps, and so on until he has completed all K%%ZSMJ15%% moves, where he moves by a_i%%ZSMJ16%% on the i%%ZSMJ17%%-th move.

For each possible initial square from 0%%ZSMJ18%% to N-1%%ZSMJ19%% (inclusive, except square X%%ZSMJ20%%), determine the square that Busy Beaver lands on after all K%%ZSMJ21%% moves are completed (including any teleports).
input: The first line contains the number of test cases T%%ZSMJ22%% (1 \le T \le 2 \cdot 10^3%%ZSMJ23%%).

The first line of each test case contains four integers N%%ZSMJ24%%, K%%ZSMJ25%%, X%%ZSMJ26%%, and Y%%ZSMJ27%% (2 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5%%ZSMJ28%%, 1 \le K \le 5 \cdot 10^5%%ZSMJ29%%, 0 \le X, Y  \lt  N%%ZSMJ30%%, X \ne Y%%ZSMJ31%%).
The second line of each test case contains K%%ZSMJ32%% integers a_1, a_2, \dots, a_K%%ZSMJ33%% (0 \le a_i  \lt  N%%ZSMJ34%%).
The sum of N%%ZSMJ35%% across all test cases does not exceed 5 \cdot 10^5%%ZSMJ36%%.
The sum of K%%ZSMJ37%% across all test cases does not exceed 5 \cdot 10^5%%ZSMJ38%%.
output: For each test case, output N-1%%ZSMJ39%% integers representing the square that Busy Beaver would land on if he started on square i%%ZSMJ40%%, for all 0 \le i  \lt  N%%ZSMJ41%% except for i = X%%ZSMJ42%%.
There are two subtasks for this problem.
(20%%ZSMJ43%% points): The sum of N%%ZSMJ44%% across all test cases does not exceed 5 \cdot 10^3%%ZSMJ45%%, and the sum of K%%ZSMJ46%% across all test cases does not exceed 5 \cdot 10^3%%ZSMJ47%%.
